name: catlet_exec
description:
Runs a non-interactive command in a catlet guest through eryph guest services (no SSH
setup, no admin rights, works off-host). stdout and stderr are merged into one output.
The command runs in the guest's configured shell: on Windows guests this is PowerShell
by default (note: 'sc' and 'type' are PowerShell aliases there - use 'sc.exe' or
'Get-Content'), on Linux guests the default shell running as root.
Not suitable for interactive programs: there is no TTY and no stdin input. A command that
waits for stdin blocks until the timeout, so redirect it (Linux: '< /dev/null') and use
non-interactive flags (e.g. apt-get -y, DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive).
Requires a running catlet with guest services - call wait_for_provisioning first.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before the command is aborted (default 300).

name: deploy_catlet
description:
Creates a new catlet (VM) from a catlet configuration. The catlet is created stopped;
call start_catlet afterwards. Creation can take several minutes when genes have to be
downloaded. If it is not finished within waitSeconds, the result contains the operation
id and status 'running' - continue with get_operation.
Catlet names must be unique within a project. Develop fodder incrementally: deploy with
a minimal configuration first, verify it, then add one fodder item at a time.

config.description: The catlet configuration as YAML (or JSON).

name.description: Overrides the catlet name from the configuration.

project.description: Overrides the project from the configuration (default: 'default').

waitSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the creation to finish (default 600).

name: get_catlet
description: Gets a catlet by id, including its status and provisioning status.

name: get_operation
description: Gets (and optionally waits for) an eryph operation, e.g. one returned by deploy_catlet.

waitSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the operation to finish (0 = return immediately).

name: get_provisioning_log
description: Gets the provisioning log of a catlet guest (fodder / cloud-init execution), including failed steps.

name: list_catlets
description: Lists catlets, optionally filtered by project name. Catlet names are not unique; use the catlet id.

name: remove_catlet
description: Deletes a catlet including its disks. This cannot be undone.

name: start_catlet
description: Starts a catlet. Afterwards use wait_for_provisioning before running commands in it.

name: stop_catlet
description: Stops a catlet. Use 'shutdown' for a graceful stop; 'hard' or 'kill' when the guest does not react.

name: validate_catlet
description:
Validates a catlet configuration (YAML or JSON) without creating anything.
Runs the schema/semantic validation and then expands the configuration: parents are
resolved, inherited fodder is merged and referenced genes are looked up (genes may be
downloaded from the genepool, which can take a while on first use).
Returns the errors or the fully expanded configuration. Always validate before deploy_catlet.

config.description: The catlet configuration as YAML (or JSON).

name: wait_for_provisioning
description:
Waits until the guest of a started catlet has finished provisioning (all fodder applied).
Guest services reporting 'available' is not enough - this waits for the provisioning
state 'completed' (or 'failed'). On failure the failed provisioning steps are returned;
use get_provisioning_log for the full log. If provisioning never starts or hangs, an
earlier fodder item most likely failed: simplify the fodder instead of debugging the network.
